analyst_eps_probe.finding: AkShare stock_research_report_em returns historical report rows but only the current 2026/2027/2028 forecast columns; historical report rows have no historical forecast values. Therefore a PIT EPS-revision history cannot be constructed from this interface.

classification: preregistered walk-forward cross-sectional ridge meta-factor research; no hyperparameter search

controls.benchmark: equal-weight all eligible HS300 members with the same monthly signal dates and 0.52% cost
controls.candidate_reference: R312/R314 frozen A+B candidate metrics, not reoptimized in this round

gates.D1_data: >=45 prediction months; feature panel and target coverage >=60% each month; all rows have signal_date < target_end
gates.G6_increment: prediction-period annual return >= benchmark +3pp and Sharpe >= benchmark +0.15
gates.G7_cost: 2x monthly cost (1.04%) still has positive prediction-period return
gates.G8_integrity: no training row has target_end >= current signal_date; no future feature rows

known_limitations: Small monthly sample and many features create overfit risk; walk-forward reduces but does not eliminate it.
The model uses current R40 local snapshot and current factor/industry data versions.
Monthly open-to-open simulation is not a full tick execution model.
The target rank/model does not include transaction impact or capacity.
The analyst EPS revision data source is not usable historically and is not part of this model.

model.prediction: top 30 by predicted target rank; equal weight; no leverage; monthly rebalance
model.standardization: training-fold feature means and standard deviations only
model.training: expanding walk-forward; at each monthly prediction, use only rows whose target end date is strictly before the current signal date; minimum 12 signal months and 1,000 training rows

periods.prediction_start: first month with 12 completed training months

preprocessing: Each feature is cross-sectionally rank-transformed to [0,1] on each signal date; missing values imputed to 0.5. No global winsorization or future scaling.
question: 把现有 PIT 因子做成固定 walk-forward 横截面 ridge 元因子，月度选 Top30，能否比等权 HS300 基准和旧的 A/B 参数更稳定，尤其改善 2022-2023 的年度体验？
selection_rule: Only the fixed ridge model is evaluated; if all gates pass, it becomes a candidate for a separate system backtest. Any failure records negative knowledge and no production change.
signal_dates: 2021-06-01 through 2026-08-31, last trading day of each month; forward target requires 20 trading sessions
target: Forward 20-trading-session open-to-open return, rank-transformed within each signal date to [0,1]; only rows with a complete target are used.
universe: R78 exact daily HS300 membership, monthly signal date last trading day
